fields.description:
Mirror inventory finding F14 (`reports/stability/mirror-inventory.md`), LOW.

## Problem

The 17 confirmable mutation verbs appear in three places:

- `src/rebar/_cli/_registry.py:680` `_CONFIRM_SCOPE` — derived, canonical
- `scripts/gen_cli_reference.py:43-46` `EDITORIAL_PREAMBLE`, emitted into `docs/cli-reference.md:8`
- `docs/user-guide.md:27` — hand-authored, the same 17 backticked names

All three agree at 17/17 today, so this is preventive. The existing gate misses BOTH prose copies:

- `_check_mutation_verbs()` (`gen_cli_reference.py:193`) compares the `MUTATION_VERBS` dict KEYS to
  `_CONFIRM_SCOPE` — not the preamble.
- `lint_editorial`'s route rule fires only on `rebar <verb>` forms, and the preamble uses bare
  backticks.
- `docs/user-guide.md` has no gate at all.

So adding a `confirmable=True` route updates the canonical set and the dict, and both prose copies
go stale silently — in exactly the documents that tell an agent which commands ask for confirmation.

## Approach — add-parity-check

Extend `_check_mutation_verbs` to parse the backticked verb list out of `EDITORIAL_PREAMBLE` and
out of `docs/user-guide.md:27`, and compare both to `_CONFIRM_SCOPE`.

Parsing prose is the right move here rather than generating it: both passages are written as
sentences with rationale, not as a bare list, and generating them would flatten guidance a reader
depends on. The check therefore asserts the SET matches while leaving the wording to a human.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [x] AC1: `_check_mutation_verbs` compares the preamble's backticked verbs to `_CONFIRM_SCOPE` and
      fails on any difference. Verified by a mutation adding a verb to the preamble and seeing RED.
- [x] AC2: it does the same for the `docs/user-guide.md` list. Verified by the equivalent mutation.
- [x] AC3: the failure names which document and which verbs, in which direction. Verified by
      asserting the message content in both mutation checks.
- [x] AC4: both prose copies pass on the committed tree, i.e. the check is green at rest and the
      17/17 agreement is confirmed rather than assumed. Verified by running the generator's checks.
- [x] AC5: the existing dict-keys comparison is retained, not replaced. Verified by the original
      assertion still being present and exercised.

## Testing

- `python scripts/gen_cli_reference.py --check` — AC1-AC5 on the committed tree.
- `python -m pytest tests/unit -k "cli_reference or mutation_verbs or editorial" -q`.
- `make lint && make typecheck`.
